title: Face-aware caption and graphic placement
what_it_does: MediaPipe finds faces and burned-in graphics shot by shot (faces.json/faces.js); captions and elements are placed away from faces, with one position held through each shot.
when_to_use: Captions or lower-thirds on a talking-head video where the speaker moves.
why: Good idea but heavy (MediaPipe install, a large TypeScript module); we would do a simple version first: sample face boxes with one ffmpeg/Python script and pick a caption row.
